messages:
Maya: Hey folks — doing a little closet purge. I have a Switch Lite (mint, case + charger) and a spare Steam key for Hades. Anyone want them? Also thinking of running a micro LAN night next Friday in the mezzanine — casual, bring your own controller. @here :partyparrot:
Liam: I’d take the Switch Lite if you can bring it to the office. How much?
Maya: Free :) happy to donate to whoever can pick up. I can drop it at someone’s desk Monday afternoon. Also need an HDMI cable + spare USB-C if anyone has extras.
Sara: I’m in for LAN night. Mario Kart + TowerFall please :racing_car:
Devon: Count me in. I can bring the dock + projector. Also have a PS4 copy of Rocket League to donate.
Raj: I can pick up the Switch on Mon. @Maya if you leave it at my desk that’s perfect :thumbsup:
Maya: Sweet — I’ll drop it after my 3pm meeting. Hades Steam key is first-come DM.
Liam: If Hades is still free after Raj claims the Switch I’ll grab it. :raised_hands:
OfficeBot: Reminder: mezzanine A/V has only 2 power strips. Please bring extension cords if you can.
Sara: Can someone bring an ethernet switch? My phone hotspot won’t cut it for more than 4 people lol.
Devon: I’ve got an 8-port gigabit switch and extra ethernet cables. Also volunteering to organize a tiny snack signup (chips + drinks).
Maya: Nice. Quick poll: start at 6pm or 7pm? React with :six: or :seven: — will pick the majority.
Raj: 6pm works better for me.
Liam: 7pm pls (I need time to finish an evening deploy)
Devon: I’ll do 6 if it helps get more people.
Maya: Cool. Logistics in one place — copying plan below so no one needs to DM:```
Pickup & items:
- Raj picks Switch Monday (Maya drops at his desk after 3pm)
- Devon brings dock + projector + 8-port switch
- Sara brings a bundle of ethernet cables
- Snacks: Devon (chips), Liam (soda)
- Bring any extra power strips / extension cords
```
Sara: Also, meme to set the mood: https://giphy.com/gifs/gaming-party-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 :joy:
Maya: Thanks everyone — will DM the Hades key and post a short RSVP thread tomorrow. See ya Fri (or Sat depending on poll)!
